name: desktop-feature-plan-actions
goal: Allow the selected local desktop project to select and approve an exact feature plan and queue its tasks.

evidence: Use local-only transport, exact project and source revision, current plan digest, readiness validation and idempotent task admission. Keep per-design approval separate and never start an unqualified provider. Verify valid, stale, foreign and remote-device cases.
Added local-only project-bound plan selection and approval with readiness-checked exact task admission. Chat controls and automatic worker scheduling remain outside this slice.

Desktop socket, preload, remote-denial and guarded action tests passed with synthetic collaborators; plan/server tests and 200 remote protocol unit tests passed. Live provider execution and full-check verification remain pending.

title: Verify committed plan approval and exact task admission without launching a provider.

evidence: The assigned feature-plan-action test uses a disposable project, Harness CLI metadata validation and real plan services; it commits a valid source contract, approves the plan and observes exactly one queued assigned task without starting the fixture provider. 4 tests passed.

title: Bind design preview image reads to an exact option when supplied.

evidence: Existing image read cases now cover two real committed options, cache hits, mismatched options, invalid socket requests and legacy no-option reads. Focused red reproduced the ignored option and focused green passed after binding it.
